purpose: Primary-source research-harness capability audit used to synthesize an original H0 construction prompt; not task material or a benchmark-score record.
audit_scope: Static inspection of indicated source sections and metadata. No packages installed, model calls made, scientific experiments run, or end-to-end quality validated.

references.name: The AI Scientist-v2

license.observed_license_name: The AI Scientist Source Code License
license.reuse_policy_for_this_work: Conceptual reference only; no upstream code or prompt text copied. Not recorded as MIT or unqualified permissive open source.
observed_terms: Distribution includes license and applicable restrictions.
Scientific-manuscript clause requires prominent disclosure of machine-generated or AI Scientist use.

observations.claim: Ideation uses a Semantic Scholar tool and iterative proposals finalized separately from experiment execution.
AgentManager explicitly sequences initial implementation, baseline tuning, creative research and ablation studies; its defaults require three Hugging Face datasets.
Journal Node associates plan/code with execution output, exceptions, metrics, plots and their own execution metadata.
The launcher invokes experiments, plot aggregation, citation gathering, writeup and paper/image review; model roles can be separately configured.
Plot aggregation instructs generated scripts to use existing experiment arrays and summaries rather than invent numerical data.
observations.inspection: selected source sections; instruction is not proof of compliance

LIT.gap: No inspected mechanism establishes our historical search/read isolation or independent LIT output contract.

IDEA.gap: Remove target workshop framing, any inherited project archive, and mandatory detailed experiment plan.

EXP.borrow: Working-code checks, experiment state, failed-run metadata, evidence-linked results.
EXP.gap: Do not import fixed stage tree, universal ablations, three-dataset rule, or method-changing creative optimization into fixed-method tasks.

WRITE_CONTENT.borrow: Write from research evidence with citation support.
WRITE_CONTENT.gap: Replace mandatory full-paper workflow with supplied independent writing scope; fixed executor rather than arbitrary role-specific models.

WRITE_PRESENTATION.borrow: Generate plots from actual stored data and preserve generation scripts.
WRITE_PRESENTATION.gap: Do not import fixed figure counts or aesthetic mandates; honor aggregate-only data.

platform.borrow: Journal records and explicit execution/error states.
platform.gap: Platform must own immutable traces, resource enforcement, version isolation and judge; self-written journal is not trusted proof.

not_adopted: Tree search or a manager agent as mandatory architecture.
Internal paper reviewer as benchmark judge.
Launcher cleanup scanning unrelated process names.

observations.claim: LaboratoryWorkflow enumerates literature review, plan formulation, data preparation/experiments, interpretation and report writing/refinement; it stores phase statistics and instantiates specialized roles.
MLESolver accepts dataset code, plan and insights; supports replacing/editing candidate code and uses a model score on plan, code and returned output.
PaperSolver is organized around building and editing a full paper and consumes experiment code/results, literature and interpretations.
